description: For bounded sums, \(A(\bar x,0)=0\) and \(A(\bar x,b+1)=A(\bar x,b)+f(\bar x,b)\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PrimitiveRecursion.boundedSum_equations.{u_1} {α : Type u_1} (f : α → ℕ → ℕ) (x : α)
  (b : ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PrimitiveRecursion.boundedSum f x 0 = 0 ∧
    Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PrimitiveRecursion.boundedSum f x (b + 1) =
      Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PrimitiveRecursion.boundedSum f x b + f x b
